verdict.rationale: Agora has a public pricing page, but the cited items from it only list product categories and one message-based free tier ('First 1 million messages free every month'). None show a published per-participant-minute or bandwidth rate for voice or video. The community cost estimate gives no unit rates, so the pack does not show a founder could model per-minute costs without contacting sales.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales
